antigravity.identifierSyntax: model identifier accepted by Antigravity CLI 1.1.26 --model
antigravity.inheritance: Omitted model and effort inherit the invoking Antigravity session
antigravity.configTarget: agy launch arguments; custom-agent model tiers are not projected from generic AIWG model ids
antigravity.artifactFormat: YAML frontmatter plus Markdown; runtime --model and --effort flags
antigravity.verification: Pinned offline contract; authenticated model selection was not executed

claude.identifierSyntax: Claude alias or accepted Anthropic model ID
claude.inheritance: Omitted agent or skill fields inherit the invoking session
claude.verification: Inspect deployed frontmatter and bounded invocation metadata

codex.identifierSyntax: Codex model slug accepted by config.toml
codex.inheritance: Omitted model and model_reasoning_effort inherit the parent session
codex.invalidPinFallback: Strict config or runtime validation; never assume fallback
codex.verification: Parse TOML and load in Codex custom-agent registry

copilot.inheritance: Omitted model uses session or Auto selection
copilot.verification: Schema fixture and entitled Copilot invocation

cursor.invalidPinFallback: Plan/admin fallback may apply; record observed result
cursor.verification: Schema fixture and entitled Cursor invocation

factory.identifierSyntax: Factory model ID or Light/Medium/Heavy complexity
factory.inheritance: Droid may inherit org/session model policy
factory.invalidPinFallback: Organization policy may substitute; record observed result
factory.verification: Fixture validation and Factory CLI model report

opencode.inheritance: Omitted agent model inherits global primary model
opencode.verification: Inspect artifact and OpenCode model registry

warp.identifierSyntax: Warp saved-profile or run model identifier
warp.inheritance: All delegated work uses run/profile selection
warp.configTarget: Warp agent profile or run configuration
warp.verification: Inspect active profile and run metadata

omp.inheritance: Omitted model and thinking level inherit the invoking Pi session
omp.invalidPinFallback: Pi resolves against its configured catalog and exits on invalid explicit selection
omp.configTarget: OMP native agent frontmatter and runtime launch arguments
omp.artifactFormat: model and thinkingLevel frontmatter; --model and --thinking runtime flags
omp.verification: Pinned OMP 18.1.10 source and live OpenRouter smoke; individual role defaults remain operator configured

pi.inheritance: Omitted model and thinking level inherit the invoking Pi session
pi.invalidPinFallback: Pi resolves against its configured catalog and exits on invalid explicit selection
pi.verification: Inspect strict JSONL state and the selected provider/model

deepseek-harness.identifierSyntax: provider/model passed through the SDK initialize request or agent-default-model Cordis row
deepseek-harness.inheritance: Subagents inherit the configured Harness route unless explicitly overridden
deepseek-harness.invalidPinFallback: Explicit unavailable routes or models fail the request
deepseek-harness.configTarget: Ephemeral Cordis route patch and SDK initialize request
deepseek-harness.verification: Pinned source contract plus opt-in headless OpenRouter smoke

windsurf.inheritance: Child behavior follows the main UI session

openclaw.inheritance: Per-agent or per-spawn override falls back to global subagent model

grokbot.identifierSyntax: No verified Grok Bot native model pin surface
grokbot.inheritance: AIWG does not invent Grok Bot model IDs; routing remains informational
grokbot.invalidPinFallback: Report unsupported; do not fabricate xAI/Grok model pins as native
grokbot.configTarget: Grok Bot has no verified AIWG-owned model config path
grokbot.verification: Confirm steward models --route --provider grokbot emits unsupported/informational

grok-build.identifierSyntax: Provider-local alias from grok inspect and $GROK_HOME config; distinct from API model id
grok-build.inheritance: Agent and skill roles resolve through the session model unless a validated Grok Build alias is selected
grok-build.invalidPinFallback: Report the unavailable alias; use the sole discovered model only when exactly one is available
grok-build.verification: grok inspect --json plus bounded parsing of model fields from reported config layers

hermes.inheritance: All delegated workers share one configured model
hermes.invalidPinFallback: Provider resolution is global; report actual model

openhuman.inheritance: Inherit delegates selection to router/provider defaults
openhuman.invalidPinFallback: Exact pins validate; semantic hints route dynamically

muse.identifierSyntax: Meta provider catalog model_id (Muse Code 1.4.0: muse-spark-1.3 current, muse-spark-1.3-contributor default, muse-spark-1.2, muse-spark-1.2-contributor), passed as muse exec --model
muse.inheritance: The session model comes from --model, else settings.json `model`, else the provider catalog default; per-agent and per-skill pins are not verified
muse.invalidPinFallback: muse exits 1 with run.terminal.failed ("model `<id>` does not exist or you lack access"); never falls back to another model
muse.verification: muse exec --json --model <id> emits run.model.configured with model_id; observed muse-spark-1.3 and muse-spark-1.3-contributor in native session logs on Muse Code 1.4.0
